content: Mmubwîzire ebyo nti lyo mulek’isârhala.
Baciyish’immuhulusa omu masinagogi, ciru amango gayiruka, ngasi owâmmuyîrhe amanye mpu kuli kukolera Nnâmahanga.
Bâmmujirire okwo kwoshi bulya barharhuma­nyaga rhwe na Larha.
Ci mmubwîzire ebyo, nti lyo hano amango gâbyo gayisha, mukengêra oku nali erhi nammubwîzire. Ntammubwîragabyo kurhenga omurhondêro, bulya naciri ekarhî kinyu.
Okuyisha kw’Omurhûlirizi
«Lêro buno nkola nâja emwa owantumaga, na ntâye muli mwe wandôsa, mpu: “Ngahi wâjà?”
“Ci bulya nammubwîzire okwo, oburhè buyunjwîre emirhima yinyu”.
“N’obwo ndesire okunali”: “kummukwânîne ngende; bulya nkaba ntagenziri, Omurhûlirizi arhammuyishire; ci nkagenda, nâmmurhumiraye”.
“N’irhondo ayisha, ayagîriza igulu oku câha, oku bushinganyanya n’oku lubà­njà”.
“Oku câha, bulya barhanyêmîri”.
“Oku bushinganyanya, bulya nkola nâja emwa Larha
, murhakanacimbona”.
“Oku lubanja, bulya omurhambo w’er’igulu atwirîrwe olubanja.
“Ncigwêrhe binji by’okummubwîra, ci murhankashub’ibihasha”.
“Irhondo olya Mûka w’okuli ayisha, ammuyigîriza okuli kwoshi; bulya arhali byâge anaderhe, ci ayish’iderha ngasi ebi ayumvîrhe byoshi, n’ebyaciyîsha, ayish’immubwîrabyo”.
“Ayish’inkuza, bulya oku byâni ayish’ihuma, ammubwîre”.
“Ebya Larha byoshi biri byâni”. Co cirhumire nderha nti”: “Oku byâni ayish’ihumakwo
, ammubwîre”».
Yezu abwîra abaganda bâge oku agaluka duba
«Hindi hitya murhâcimbone, na hindi hitya mwâshub’imbona
Obwo baguma omu baganda bâge babwizanya, mpu: «Kwo kurhi okwo adwîrhe arhubwîra, mpu: “Hindi hitya murhâcimbone, na hindi hitya mwâshub’imbona”, na mpu: “Najà emwa Larha?”»
Okubundi bakaziderha, mpu «Ehyo hitya kwo kuderha kurhi? Rhurhamanyiri ebi alonza okuderha».
Yezu amanya oku balonza okumudôsa. Anacibabwîra, erhi: «Mudwîrhe mwadôsanya ebi nalonzagya okummubwîra ene nderha, nti: “Hindi bitya murhâcimbone, na hindi hitya mwâshub’imbona”».
«Okuli, okuli, mmubwîre, mwayish’ilaka munalakûle; igulu lyôhe lyayish’icîshinga; mwêhe mwayish’ibona oburhè, ci oburhè bwinyu bwayish’ihinduka mwishingo

“Omukazi, nk’ali hôfi h’okuburha, oburhè bunamugwârhe, bulya amango gâge gahisire; ci kwônene nk’amâyûs’iburha omwâna, arhacikengêra galya malibuko gâge, erhi kucîshinga kurhuma, bulya omuntu abusirwe en’igulu”.
“Ninyu kwo n’okwo”. “Buno muli burhè; ci nâcimubone n’omurhima gwinyu gwâshagaluke, n’obusîme bwinyu ntâye wâcimmukûle kuli bwo”.
“Olwo lusiku ntâco mwâcindôse”. “Okuli, okuli, mmubwîre, eci mwâhûne Larha, ammushobôzaco oku izîno lyâni”.
“Kuhika buno, ntâco musig’ihûna oku izîno lyâni. Hûni, mwâhâbwa, n’obusîme bwinyu bwâbà bwimâna”.
“Ebyo byoshi nammubwîzirebyo omu migani”. “Amango gayiruka, ntakacimmubwîra omu migani; nâmmushambalira ebya Larha n’obwâlagale”
“Agôla mango, mwâhûne oku izîno lyâni. Ntadesiri nti nayîsh’immusengerera emwa Larha”,
“kulya kubà Larha yêne ammuzigira, bulya munzigira munayêmîre oku nahubukaga muli Nyamuzinda”.
“Nahubukaga muli Larha, najà en’igulu”. “Buno nkola nârhenga en’igulu, njè emwa Larha”».
Abaganda bâge bamubwîra, mpu: «Lêro oshambîre n’obwâlagale, orhanadwîrhi waderhera omu migani!
Lêro rhwamâbona oku oyishi byoshi, na ntâye ocilagirîre oku­kudôsa. Lêro rhwamâyêmêra oku wahubukaga muli Nyamuzinda».
Yezu abashuza, erhi: «Ka lêro mwamâyêmêra?
Amango gayiruka, ciru ganakola gahisire, mwâshandabana ngasi muguma lwâge, munansige niene. Ci ntali niene, nanga, bulya Larha ali nâni.
Nammubwîzire ebyo nti lyo mubona omurhûla muli nie. Mwâbone amalumwa omu igulu. Ci muzibuhe! Nahimire igulu».

footnotes.text: 16, 10 Mûka Mutagatîfu ayish’iyêrekana oku kwo binali Yezu ali Mwene-Nyamuzinda. Okurheremera kwa Yezu omu mpingu ekulyo kw’Îshe ciri cimanyîso c’okuyêrekana oku muli Nyamuzinda anarhengaga.
16, 15 Mûka Mutagatîfu ayish’imanyîsa, ayish’ihamîriza Yezu n’enyigîrizo zâge; ayish’imanyîsa oku Nyamuzinda Îshe n’Omugala bali muguma.
16, 16 Aho Yezu abwîzire abaganda bâge oku âfà anafûke.
16, 20 Bayish’ibona oburhè amango g’amalumwa n’okufà kwa Yezu; ci olusiku âfûka bayumva omwîshingo.
16, 25 Entumwa zâyumve enyigîrizo za Mwâmi Yezu n’obwâlagale amango âfûka anabarhumira Mûka Mutagatîfu.
